Name: Bella's Fantasy Accessories Pack
Author: Bellassims
Description:
[img]https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/865/75/fantasy-mod-preview.png[/img]

Fashion Sense is required.
 
Mix and match different Fantasy accessories to make your fantasy character come to life in Stardew Valley, from Wings to Horns to Animal ears and tails, most items are even animated!
 
There's a lot of options already included however I'll be revisiting at different times in the future to expand on different areas to add in even more possible customisation! On that note, I am open to suggestions for future, you can find me as @Bellassims here, on Twitter, Twitch, and Youtube.

Manifest.Name: Bella's Fantasy Accessories Pack
Manifest.Description: Adds a variety of new fantasy themed accessories to use with Fashion Sense.
